always_valid.label: secondary
always_valid.method: mSPRT, normal mixing distribution N(0, tau^2), plug-in variance
always_valid.tau_rule: tau = |pilot lanes_v1 - pilot control| for mean cost and for solve rate, from runs/pilot-* only; the pilot's standard error of that difference if the difference is zero

frontier.label: secondary
frontier.note: Batches ran on different task pools (pilot, exp1, rollout, exp2), so comparisons across batches are descriptive; only arms within one experiment were randomised.
frontier.on_frontier: exp1 lanes_v1, rollout lanes_v1, pilot control

projection.basis: 1000 x exp1 cost per solved task
projection.label: arithmetic on measured figures, not a measurement
